title: docs(workflow): Claude-only workflow, up to 4 builders, Ready queue, Cursor removed (JAS-27)
body:
**Tier:** risky. It changes `.claude/agents/`, `.claude/settings.json`, `.claude/hooks/`, `.claude/skills/` and `scripts/risky-paths.ts`, which are all on the risky list, and it changes the rules every builder follows.
**Builder:** Claude Code on Opus 5.5, in a local session.
Linear: JAS-27 (closes on merge from the branch name). Replaces #191 (JAS-21), now closed.
